title: Counting to 20 and beyond
examples: Teacher, how do I count past ten?
Can we count backwards from fifteen?
If I start at twelve, what comes next?

explain.say: After ten, you keep counting in the same order. Eleven, twelve and thirteen come next.
The numbers from eleven to nineteen are the teen numbers. Each one is ten and some more.
After nineteen comes twenty. Twenty is two tens.
You can count on from any number. Start at twelve and say thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.
You can count back too. Start at fifteen and say fourteen, thirteen, twelve.

faq.q: What is the pattern for the teen numbers?
faq.a: Each teen number is ten and some more. Thirteen is ten and three. Nineteen is ten and nine.
asks: How do I know the teen numbers?
What is the rule for 11 to 19?

faq.q: How do I count forwards from a number like twelve?
faq.a: You just keep adding one each time you say the number. You say thirteen, then fourteen, then fifteen.
asks: Can you count up from here?

faq.a: Counting backwards means saying the numbers in reverse order. You go down the number line.
asks: Can we count from twenty to ten?

faq.q: If I start at fifteen, what is the next number?
faq.a: The number right after fifteen is sixteen. We always count up by one.

faq.q: Do I have to know all the numbers up to twenty?
faq.a: It helps to know them all, but the most important thing is knowing the pattern. You can count on your fingers too.
asks: Do I need to memorize them?
Is it okay if I forget one number?

facts: The teen numbers are from eleven to nineteen.
Counting forwards means increasing the number by one each time.
Counting backwards means decreasing the number by one each time.
The number twenty comes right after nineteen.

quiz.say: Count on from 19. Tap the next number.
quiz.why: After nineteen comes twenty. Twenty is two tens.

wrong.0: Twenty-one comes after twenty, so it is one step too far.
wrong.2: After nineteen the count goes up to a new ten, which is twenty.

quiz.say: Count back from 15. Tap the next number.
quiz.why: Counting back goes down by one. One less than fifteen is fourteen.

wrong.0: Sixteen is one more, but counting back goes down.
wrong.2: Thirteen is two steps back, so go back just one step.

quiz.say: Ten and three more. Tap the number.
quiz.why: Ten and three make thirteen. You write a 1 and then a 3.

wrong.0: Thirty-one is three tens and one, which is much bigger.
wrong.2: Thirty is three tens, and you have just one ten here.
